```{julia}
#| include: false
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(joinpath(@__DIR__, "../../../AmberMakie/docs"))
using Amber, AmberMakie, CairoMakie
using Statistics
CairoMakie.activate!()
set_theme!(theme_amber_light())
```

An odd number of inverters connected in a loop has no stable Boolean state.
This project models five transistor-level stages, including channel-length
modulation and gate capacitances, and lets oscillation emerge from a small
initial imbalance.

## Define one reusable inverter stage

```{julia}
const PROJECT_RING_NMOS = Level1MOSFET(threshold_voltage=0.7V,
    transconductance=2mA/V^2, channel_length_modulation=0.03/V,
    gate_source_capacitance=2pF, gate_drain_capacitance=0.5pF)
const PROJECT_RING_PMOS = Level1MOSFET(threshold_voltage=0.7V,
    transconductance=1mA/V^2, channel_length_modulation=0.03/V,
    gate_source_capacitance=2pF, gate_drain_capacitance=0.5pF)

@subcircuit ProjectRingStage(input, output, supply, reference;
        load_capacitance=5pF, initial_output=nothing) begin
    PullUp = pmos(output, input, supply, supply; model=PROJECT_RING_PMOS)
    PullDown = nmos(output, input, reference, reference; model=PROJECT_RING_NMOS)
    Load = capacitor(output, reference; value=load_capacitance)
    if initial_output !== nothing
        initial_voltage(Load, initial_output)
    end
end
```

Hierarchy keeps the circuit readable and preserves paths such as
`First.PullUp` for later diagnostics and result inspection.

```{julia}
@circuit ProjectRingOscillator(; supply_voltage=5V,
        load_capacitance=5pF, startup_offset=50mV) begin
    gnd = ground(); supply = node()
    stage1 = node(); stage2 = node(); stage3 = node()
    stage4 = node(); stage5 = node()
    VDD = voltage_source(supply, gnd; dc=supply_voltage)

    First = ProjectRingStage(stage5, stage1, supply, gnd;
        load_capacitance, initial_output=supply_voltage/2 + startup_offset)
    Second = ProjectRingStage(stage1, stage2, supply, gnd;
        load_capacitance, initial_output=supply_voltage/2 - startup_offset)
    Third = ProjectRingStage(stage2, stage3, supply, gnd;
        load_capacitance, initial_output=supply_voltage/2 + startup_offset)
    Fourth = ProjectRingStage(stage3, stage4, supply, gnd;
        load_capacitance, initial_output=supply_voltage/2 - startup_offset)
    Fifth = ProjectRingStage(stage4, stage5, supply, gnd;
        load_capacitance, initial_output=supply_voltage/2 + startup_offset)

    observe(voltage(stage1), voltage(stage2), voltage(stage3),
        voltage(stage4), voltage(stage5), current(VDD))
end

oscillator = ProjectRingOscillator()
(
    stages=length(devices(oscillator; under="First")),
    diagnostics=check(oscillator),
)
```

## Simulate startup, then measure only the settled interval

```{julia}
startup = transient(oscillator, 0s => 1μs;
    max_step=1ns, saveat=1ns)
settled_interval = 0.5μs => 1μs
harmonics = harmonic_analysis(startup; signal=voltage(:stage5),
    interval=settled_interval, fundamental=:auto, harmonics=8)

settled_samples = startup.axis .>= first(settled_interval)
average_supply_current = mean(current(startup, :VDD)[settled_samples])

(
    oscillation_frequency=harmonics.fundamental.frequency,
    average_supply_current,
    thd_percent=100harmonics.thd,
)
```

```{julia}
figure = Figure(size=(1100, 760))
traceplot(figure[1, 1], startup;
    signals=[:stage1, :stage2, :stage3, :stage4, :stage5])
harmonicplot(figure[2, 1], harmonics)
Label(figure[0, 1], "Five-stage CMOS ring: startup and settled harmonics";
    fontsize=21)
figure
```

The upper panel makes propagation around the ring visible. The lower panel is
computed only from the second half of the record, separating limit-cycle
behavior from the deliberately perturbed startup transient.

::: {.callout-tip}
Try changing `load_capacitance`. More capacitance increases each stage delay,
which lowers the oscillation frequency and usually changes the supply current.
:::
